gloss: rise and fall of fashions; passing fads

definitions.gloss: rise and fall of fashions; ups and downs of popularity
definitions.explanation: The way things come into fashion and then go out again. Used of clothes, music, words, foods or businesses whose popularity keeps changing.

examples.english: Clothes go in and out of fashion.

examples.japanese: {若者言葉|わかものことば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: Youth slang comes and goes very quickly.

examples.japanese: {流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{愛|あい}される→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りたい→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make a classic product that people love for a long time, regardless of passing fads.

notes:
The stems of ⟦{流行|はや}る→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧ (to become popular) and {廃|すた}る (to go out of use) joined as a pair, like ⟦{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み→浮き沈み：09611_ukishizumi⟧ (ups and downs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to go in and out of fashion
- {流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ / ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: fashions change fast
- {流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧: not swayed by passing fads
- {流行|はや}り{廃|すた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: timeless, never out of fashion
